og.alt: Primitives (@pyreon/primitives): One Toggle. The real iOS switch and the real Android switch.

hero.alt: One <Toggle value onChange> in a .tsx file on the left. Lines run to three targets on the right: a web input with role="switch", a SwiftUI Toggle on iOS and a Jetpack Compose Switch on Android. When the value flips, all three switches flip together. Native targets are experimental.

today-android.alt: Today, the showcase todo app, on an Android emulator (Jetpack Compose generated from the same TodayApp.tsx): the "Today" heading with "2 left", a Material text field with an ember Add button, and three todos, each with a Material switch (Book the dentist on) and a Remove action.

today-ios.alt: Today, the showcase todo app, on an iOS Simulator (SwiftUI generated from the same TodayApp.tsx): the "Today" heading with "2 left", an "Add a todo" text field with an ember Add button, and three todos, each with a native iOS switch (Book the dentist on) and a Remove action.

today-web.alt: Today, the showcase todo app, in Chromium (the web build: server-rendered HTML, hydrated): a "Today" heading with "2 left", an "Add a todo" field with an ember Add button, and three todos on paper cards (Water the basil, Book the dentist checked off, Call Grandma back), each with a checkbox and a Remove action.
